thread:
sarah_sales: Hey team — BlueHarbor POC is asking for a 10% holdback on the first invoice until production acceptance. Need legal wording and signature flow. CC @devon_cse

devon_cse: Thanks. POC is Dedicated 4-week pilot, expected peak ~8 rps. Acceptance: latency <200ms p50, pass the SKU-level eval harness. If holdback stays, deployment schedule might shift.

olivia_finance: Net30 is our default. Holdback should be an invoice line item. Who's the billing entity? Customer requests EU invoicing.

mike_legal: Proposed clause for addendum: ```If Customer withholds up to 10% of the invoiced amount pending acceptance testing, such amount shall be payable within 30 days after written acceptance or within 60 days from the invoice date, whichever occurs first.``` Also requires DPA cross-border language for EU invoicing. I'll draft a redline now.

sarah_sales: Also need signer order — procurement + legal. Our standard is exec countersign for orderform totals > $50k. Can we make exec conditional?

mike_legal: We can do conditional exec counterparty for amounts > $75k. I'll include an exec-approval exception clause and an approvals annex.

devon_cse: Heads up — if they insist on EU data residency that becomes a scope change to Private deployment; that affects pricing and billing timeline.

olivia_finance: For EU invoicing we should route to Redwood EU Ltd and include VAT line. Sales-ops, please confirm whether BlueHarbor has a VAT ID.

sales-ops: noted. We'll check VAT ID and prepare EU orderform template. If Redwood EU Ltd is selected, invoices will be generated there.

mike_legal: Uploading redline to the shared doc and tagging sales-ops. Also recommend acceptance sign-off be a named contact in the SOW to avoid disputes.

sarah_sales: Great. Once redline is ready can legal-esign start a DocuSign envelope with signer order: Procurement -> Legal -> Exec (exec only if conditional triggers)? @legal-esign

legal-esign: Acknowledged. We'll prepare envelope with conditional signer steps. Expect draft in 1 business day. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Contract 1733337777 created and assigned to sales-ops queue.

mike_legal: Redline uploaded: https://redwood.internal/docs/redlines/1733337777 :eyes:

sarah_sales: Thanks — I'll update BlueHarbor with the timeline and tag back once they confirm VAT and signers.

olivia_finance: Once signed we'll issue invoice per the selected billing entity. I prefer orderform+invoice attachment to keep terms explicit.

sarah_sales: Closing the loop for now. I'll follow up after they confirm VAT ID and signers.
